title: Export request
description: Body of POST /v1/sessions/{session_id}/exports (release 1.2.0): ask AlixAI to generate a downloadable file from a turn's verified rich blocks. The core never accepts model-written file bytes; it re-reads blocks it already validated and renders them deterministically. csv and xlsx need at least one table or chart block among the selection; html and md accept any verified blocks of the turn.

turn_id.description: The turn whose verified blocks to export. Must resolve in the caller's scope.

block_ids.description: Optional subset of block ids from the turn (the AG-UI activity ids act_<turn>_bN, or the 1-based block index as a decimal string). Absent or empty means every verified block of the turn.
